properties.name: email.inference.max-concurrent-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent LiteLLM classifier requests.

properties.name: email.inference.log-prompts
properties.description: Logs every LiteLLM user prompt plus the response; the fixed system prompt is omitted. Enabled by the dev profile; logs contain complete email bodies.

properties.name: email.inference.summary-max-concurrent-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent LiteLLM summary requests.

properties.name: email.inference.tag-system-prompt-location
properties.description: Classpath or filesystem location of the email tagging system prompt.

properties.name: gmail.polling.enabled
properties.description: Whether scheduled Gmail polling is enabled.

properties.name: gmail.polling.initial-lookback-days
properties.description: Number of days to scan when no completed polling checkpoint exists.

properties.name: gmail.polling.interval
properties.description: Delay between completed Gmail polling runs.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.base-url
properties.description: LiteLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Read from LITELLM_BASE_URL.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.api-key
properties.description: LiteLLM API key. Read from LITELLM_API_KEY.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.chat.options.model
properties.description: LiteLLM model name used for every inference request. Defaults to email-router via LITELLM_MODEL.
